mentions.name: CT RailTime
mentions.description: An app that improves traveling on CTrail, offering a reliable alternative to CTDOT's outsourced official app, which is described as bad and broken most of the time.
mentions.problem: CTDOT's outsourced app for CTrail is bad and broken most of the time, so riders lack a working app for their trips.
mentions.audience: People who ride CTrail, who currently deal with an unreliable official CTDOT app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm still working on CT RailTime. It's an app I made to make traveling on CTrail better.
mentions.author: willmeyers

mentions.name: CT RailTime
mentions.description: This app provides a better way to travel on CTrail, serving as an improved alternative to the state's broken official eTix app.
mentions.problem: CTrail's current eTix app is essentially broken and the CT government does not seem to care enough to fix it.
mentions.audience: Travelers on the CTrail commuter rail line
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on CT RailTime (https://ctrailtime.com), a better way to travel on CTrail. Their current eTix app is essentially broken and the CT government does not seem to care enough to fix it.
mentions.author: willmeyers
